There are no "Your answer" / "Correct answer" labels, no status chip, no "n of N" position, no difficulty or time, no Hide answers, no Report and no Save. On a phone it sits at the bottom of a 2,800px page.

Unique to us and good, but three things are wrong. It silently stops at 12 (a 13-miss section showed 12). It numbers questions globally ("Q26") while the grid numbers them per module ("M2 4"). And it lists a missed grid-in under its skill name ("Two-way table") as if that were a misconception.
Ours only: POST /api/drill {from_session} turns every miss into a fresh question on the same template. It comes in one variant only: all misses, blanks included, once each.
The mastery bars animate from before to after on a drill report.
Not on the report or in the session.
No print, CSV or link. (The results endpoint has no ownership check, so a link already works by accident.)

Better than theirs: it fills from any scored sitting. But it has no legend, no target line, no tooltip, and points can't be clicked. Same-day sittings are all labelled "Sep 23", and there are no range or kind filters.

19 tiles with a mastery bar and an open-mistake dot. Every tile links to a generic /practice/, with no counts, no accuracy and no skill detail.

Each row shows date, kind, topic glyphs and score only. There are no wrong-question chips, no duration, no filters, no sort, no Fix action and no in-progress/resume. Ordering ties on same-second finishes because the sort is finished DESC with no tie-break.

A new learner sees a giant black dash where the score goes and a quiet "Take a test" link. A bad id shows a dash bar, one error line and an orphan "QUESTIONS" heading, with no way back. An unfinished DRILL's report redirects to /test/ (the exam runner) instead of /practice/session/.
The drill summary never links to /results/report/ for that set, although the endpoint serves drills.

# Score report and results — rebuild spec

This covers two pages, `/results/report/?id=` (one sitting) and `/results/` (overview), plus the review player that both open. The player uses the practice session's layout, as the user asked ("the practice one is the best").

## 0. Rules for this section
- No rule from the old rebuild binds this page: several pills are allowed, borders are allowed, and labels, legends and one-line helpers are allowed. Each screen still has one primary (orange-filled) button.
- **Colour semantics, fixed site-wide from now on:** orange = needs your attention (incorrect, open mistake, selected). The key is marked with a check glyph and the word "Correct answer", not with a colour. Every status carries a glyph as well as a fill, so nothing depends on colour alone.
  - **Correct:** `--tile-2` fill, ink number, a small ✓ in the top-right corner.
  - **Incorrect:** `--amber` fill, `--ink-deep` number, a ✕ corner.
  - **Incorrect, fixed since:** `--wash` fill, a 1.5px `--amber-deep` edge and a ✓ corner. The miss's trap has since closed.
  - **Unanswered:** paper fill, a 1.5px dashed `--faint` edge, a soft number and a "–" corner.
  - **Flagged:** a graphite bookmark notch in the top-left corner.
  - **Repair (practice set):** a ↻ glyph in the bottom-right corner.
  - **Current:** a 2px ink ring.
- **Numbering is one scheme everywhere:** "M1 Q7" / "M2 Q4" for a section, "Q7" for a one-module test, diagnostic or practice set. The grid, the mistakes list, the table, the player, the chips on the results list and the URL hash all use it.
- **Difficulty glyph:** three ascending bars (1, 2 or 3 filled) plus the word Easy / Medium / Hard. It is never shown by colour alone.
- **Fonts:** DM Mono for every count, time and percentage, Source Serif 4 for question text, Archivo for everything else.

## 1. Report page `/results/report/?id=<sid>`

### 1.1 Layout
- **Desktop (≥1100):** `main.page`, max 1120, a 12-column grid with a 24px gap. Sections stack top to bottom in the order below, each opened by a `.k` eyebrow label and an optional one-line helper in `--soft`.
- **Tablet (860–1099):** the same order, two-column tiles.
- **Phone (390):** 16px gutters and one column. Tiles run 3 per row (summary) or 2 per row (domains). The header action bar sticks under the top bar once the hero scrolls away, showing the primary button plus a ⋯ overflow. No horizontal page scroll anywhere. The chart and grid scale to width; the table becomes stacked cards.

### 1.2 Header (`#head`)
- **Back link:** "← Results" (to `/results/`).
- **Eyebrow, by kind:**
  - mock: "PRACTICE TEST · FULL MATH SECTION · ADAPTIVE"
  - module: "PRACTICE TEST · ONE MODULE"
  - diagnostic: "DIAGNOSTIC"
  - drill: "PRACTICE SET"
  - challenge: "DAILY CHALLENGE · SEP 23"
- **Title line:** "Wed, Sep 23, 2026 · 6:15 AM · 64 min". Minutes come from `ms` and are omitted when `ms` is null.
- **Actions, right-aligned on desktop and a row under the title on phone:**
  1. **Primary pill** "Fix these · 13", which is split: the main part runs the default (every miss, once each); a ⌄ opens a menu:
     - "Incorrect only · 11" (`only` = incorrect qids)
     - "Each miss twice · 26" (`each: 2`)
     - "Not answered · 2"
     - When a review filter is active: "Just the 4 shown"
     - All of these POST `/api/drill {from_session, only?, each?}` and go to `/practice/session/?id=`.
  2. **Outline button** "Review mistakes": opens the player filtered to Incorrect + Unanswered.
  3. **Outline button** "Redo with new numbers": POST `/api/drill {from_session, scope:"all", timed:true}`. It asks every template of the sitting again with fresh seeds, at test pace (a 44-question section runs 70 min).
  4. **⋯ menu:** "Copy share link" (read-only), "Print / Save as PDF" (`window.print()`), "Download CSV" (the question table, built client-side as a Blob).
- **No misses at all:** the primary becomes "Harder next · New section" (mock) or "Keep going" (drill, the coach's pick), and the helper reads "No misses. Every question right."
- **Not the owner** (`mine: false`): a read-only strip reading "Shared report · read-only". Fix, Redo, Save, Try-one-like-this and Report are hidden.

### 1.3 Score hero (`#hero`)
**Mock, module and diagnostic.** Two columns on desktop (gauge 5 columns, facts 7 columns); stacked on phone.
- **Gauge component (`UI.gauge`):** a 240° arc from 200 to 800.
  - Tick labels 200 / 400 / 600 / 800.
  - This sitting's band is an orange arc segment from low to high, with a graphite tick at its middle.
  - The previous scored sitting's band is a `--mat` ghost segment.
  - The target (`profile.target`) is a dashed ink tick labelled "Target 700".
  - Centre: "520–660" (Archivo 800, 56px desktop / 44px phone), and under it "Math · middle 590".
- **Facts column:**
  - "31 of 44 correct · 70%".
  - A delta chip: "+90 vs last section (Sep 20)", from the midpoint difference. It reads "First section" when there is no previous one.
  - Target line: "Target 700 · 40 above this high end". It reads "Target reached" when high ≥ target and is omitted when there is no target.
  - Route line:
    - Upper route: "Module 1: 15/22 (68%). 60% or more earns the harder Module 2."
    - Lower route: "Module 1: 11/22 (50%) → easier Module 2, which tops out at 580."
    - Capped: add "Capped at 580 by the easier route."
  - A `<details>` "How this is estimated" with three lines:
    - "Each question counts by difficulty: easy 1, medium 2, hard 3."
    - "The band is ±70 (±100 on the diagnostic) because these questions are not calibrated on real test-takers."
    - "College Board's own simulation caps the easier Module 2 at 580."

**Drill.**
- Big "5/12" plus "42%" in mono.
- Meta: "10 asked + 2 repairs · 17 min · Nonlinear functions, Probability".
- Under it, the existing topic rows (before → after mastery bar, right/asked).
- A line "4 mistakes opened · 1 fixed", each count linking to the Mistakes section.

**Challenge.**
- Big "8/10" and "9:42".
- "#12 of 140 today" and a "Board" link.

### 1.4 Summary tiles (`#tiles`, component `UI.tile`)
Six tiles: 6 across on desktop, 3×2 on phone. Each has a label, a value (mono 26px) and an optional sub-line.
| label | value | sub-line |
|---|---|---|
| Correct | 31 | — |
| Incorrect | 11 | — |
| Unanswered | 2 | — |
| Accuracy | 70% | "76% of answered" |
| Time | 64:12 | "of 70:00", or omitted when untimed |
| Per question | 1:27 | "test pace 1:35" |

- A drill replaces Unanswered with "Repairs · 2".
- When the sitting has no time data (old sittings), both time tiles read "—", with the sub-line "Not recorded for this sitting".

### 1.5 Modules (`#modules`, mock only)
- Two tiles side by side (stacked on phone):
  - "Module 1 · mixed · 15/22 · 68% · 31:40 of 35:00"
  - "Module 2 · harder · 16/22 · 73% · 34:05 of 35:00"
- Each tile has a 22-segment strip coloured by status. Clicking a segment opens the player there.

### 1.6 Domains (`#domains`)
- Four cards (4 across desktop, 2×2 phone). Each card has:
  - The domain name.
  - "73%" (value, mono 28px).
  - "11 of 15 correct".
  - The band word ("Steady").
  - A **per-question segment bar** with one segment per question in that domain, status-coloured; each segment is clickable and opens the player.
  - Share copy: "15 of 44 questions · 35% of the section". This replaces their "20% of test section, 1-5 questions".
  - Delta: "+2 vs Sep 20", only if a previous sitting of the same kind exists.
  - A disclosure "Skills ▾" that expands topic rows: glyph, short name, right/asked, a mini bar, and an open-mistake count ("2 open"). Clicking a topic row applies that topic as a review filter and scrolls to the review.
- **Drills** get domains too (the server computes them).
- **Helper under the heading:** "A domain is a handful of questions, so treat one bad card as a hint, not a verdict."

### 1.7 Difficulty and format (`#split`)
- **Easy / Medium / Hard rows:** difficulty glyph, "6/6 · 100%", and a bar.
- **"Multiple choice 25/34 · Grid-in 6/10" rows.**
- Clicking a row sets the matching review filter.

### 1.8 Pace (`#pace`; hidden when there is no time data)
- **Bar chart:** one bar per question in order, with a thin gap between M1 and M2. Bar height is seconds; the bar is status-coloured.
- A dashed line at 95s labelled "Test pace 1:35".
- The y-axis caps at 5:00, with an overflow arrow above any bar past it.
- Tapping or hovering a bar shows a tooltip "M2 Q19 · 4:12 · Incorrect · Hard"; clicking opens the player.
- **Chips under the chart** (each chip is a review filter):
  - "Rushed misses 3 (under 0:30 and wrong)"
  - "Long solves 4 (over 3:10)"
  - "Slowest: M2 Q19 4:12"
- On phone, 44 bars fit about 7px each within 358px.

### 1.9 Mistakes (`#mistakes`)
- **Heading:** "Mistakes · 13", with the helper "9 named misconceptions · 2 grid-ins · 2 not answered · 3 fixed since".
- **Rows:**
  - **Misconception row:** the topic glyph, then the misconception text (600 15px). Meta line: "M1 Q1 · Linear inequalities · Hard". State:
    - "Open · 2 clean answers to close", with an orange dot;
    - or "Fixed Sep 24", with a ✓ and the text struck through lightly, as the session already does.
    - Buttons: "Review" (opens the player) and "Fix" (a 2-question drill on that template: `{from_session, only:[qid], each:2}`).
  - **Grid-in misses:** text "Missed grid-in", with the skill in the meta line ("Two-way table").
  - **Not answered:** a collapsed group "Not answered · 2" listing its chips.
- **Repeats:** the same misconception hit more than once is grouped into one row, "×2", with both question refs as chips.
- **Sort select:** "Question order / Open first / By topic".
- **Length:** rows collapse after 8, with a "Show all 13" button. Nothing is ever silently cut.

### 1.10 Question review (`#review`)
**Toolbar**
- It sticks under the page bar on scroll on desktop; on phone it scrolls horizontally inside itself only.
- **"Show" radio segmented control, with live counts:** All 44 · Incorrect 11 · Unanswered 2 · Correct 31 · Flagged 3 · Saved 1. Flagged is hidden for drills; Saved is hidden when 0.
- **Selects:**
  - Domain: All + 4.
  - Topic: filled from the domain chosen.
  - Difficulty: All / Easy / Medium / Hard.
  - Format: All / Multiple choice / Grid-in.
- **"Colour by" segmented:** Status | Difficulty | Time.
- **"View" segmented:** Grid | Table.
- A "Reset" link, shown only when a filter is set.
- The filter state lives in the URL query (`?id=..&show=incorrect&domain=Algebra`), so it survives reload and share.

**Legend** (always visible, changes with Colour by)
- Status: Correct ✓ · Incorrect ✕ · Fixed since · Unanswered – · Flagged · Repair.
- Difficulty: three swatches (`--tile` / `--mat` / `--ink` with a white number) plus the glyph.
- Time: a 4-step warm-grey ramp labelled "0:30 · 1:35 · 3:10 · 5:00+".

**Grid view**
- One group per module, with a heading like "Module 1 · 15/22 · 31:40" (or "Questions · 5/12" for a single group).
- Cells are 40px on desktop and 44px on phone (7 per row), each a `<button>` with an aria-label like "M1 Q7, incorrect, hard, 1:42, flagged".
- Cells that the filter excludes stay in place at 30% opacity and are skipped by prev/next and by Tab.
- Challenge cells show the crowd % under the number ("41%").

**Table view**
- Columns: # · Skill (glyph + topic, skill label under it) · Difficulty · Format · Time · Your answer · Correct · Result · Mistake.
- Sortable by #, Time, Difficulty and Result, with `aria-sort` on the headers.
- On phone each row is a stacked card: a line "M1 Q7 · Hard · 1:42", the skill, "You: B · Key: D", then the mistake text.

### 1.11 Review player (`UI.review`, a shared overlay)
- **Frame:** a full-viewport `<dialog>` in the practice session's layout: a sticky 60px top bar, a centred 700px question column, a sticky bottom bar. It opens from any cell, row, chip, mistake or segment. The URL hash becomes `#q=m1-7`, so the back button closes it and a pasted link opens at that question. Esc closes it and returns focus to the cell that opened it.
- **Top bar:**
  - Left: × Close.
  - Centre: the navigator.
    - Sittings of 24 questions or fewer get a segment strip of every question in status colours, the current one ringed.
    - Longer sittings get the compact pill "M1 Q7 · 7 of 44 ⌄", which opens a popover grid (same cells and legend) with an Esc close.
  - Right tools:
    - Hide answers (eye toggle)
    - Save (bookmark)
    - Calculator
    - Reference
    - Report problem (flag)
  - On phone the last two go into a ⋯ menu.
- **Question header:**
  - The topic glyph and topic, then the skill label ("Two-way table").
  - The difficulty glyph and word, and "Multiple choice" / "Grid-in".
  - "1:42 · pace 1:35".
  - A "Flagged in test" tag if flagged; an "Again" tag if it was a repair.
  - A status chip on the right: "Incorrect" / "Correct" / "Not answered" / "Incorrect · fixed since".
- **Body** (`UI.question` in review mode):
  - Stem in serif, then the figure or table.
  - **Multiple choice:**
    - The keyed option gets a ✓ and the tag "Correct answer".
    - A picked wrong option gets a ✕ and the tag "Your answer".
    - A right pick gets "Your answer · Correct".
    - Under the picked wrong option: its misconception in 600 14.5px ("Used the largest recorded value as the bottom of the range…").
    - A toggle "Why each wrong answer is wrong" reveals the misconception under EVERY wrong option (`reasons[]`). It defaults closed, and its state is remembered in localStorage.
  - **Grid-in:** two boxes side by side, "Your answer −7" and "Correct answer 8/161". Under them, when present: "Also accepted: .0496, .0497" (`accepted`).
  - **Not answered:** "You left this blank." above the key.
  - **Explanation card:** `--tile` fill, heading "Explanation", then the rationale in serif.
  - **Mistake state line:** "Open mistake · 2 clean answers to close" or "Fixed Sep 24 ✓".
  - **Challenge only:** "41% of 140 students got this right."
- **Actions row:**
  - Primary pill "Try one like this". It POSTs `/api/drill {from_session, only:[qid], scope:"all", count:1}` and renders the fresh twin INLINE below, in a tile headed "Same skill, new numbers", using normal answer mode. Answering goes through `/api/drill/{id}/answer` (so it files an attempt and can close the trap) and shows the usual verdict. The buttons then become "Another like this" (the next question of a new 1-question drill) and "Back to the original".
  - Outline button "Try it again": the same as Hide answers. It is local only and not recorded.
  - Quiet link "5 more like this": a drill with `each:5`, which navigates to the session.
- **Hide answers:** hides the key marks, the "Your answer" tags, the mistake, the explanation and the status chip, and makes the options pickable. A pick reveals locally ("A · right this time") and restores everything.
- **Bottom bar:** "← Previous" | the position within the active filter ("7 of 11 incorrect") | "Next →". When the filter is All, a quiet "Next miss" also appears.
- **Keys:** ←/→ or J/K move; N = next miss; H = hide answers; S = save; T = try one like this; A–D / 1–4 pick while hidden; Esc closes. A hint row on hover devices reads "← → move · N next miss · H hide". It is hidden on touch.

### 1.12 Up next (`#next`)
- The coach's pick from `/api/map`: topic chips, "10 questions · 16 min", a "Start" pill and a "New section" link.
- It sits last on the page, under a divider.

### 1.13 States
- **Loading:** static skeletons of the real sizes (a gauge circle, 6 tile blocks, 44 cells) with `aria-busy="true"` on main. No dash characters, and nothing loops.
- **404:** the heading "That sitting does not exist.", with links "All results" and "Tests". No section headings render.
- **403 diagnostic** (not signed up): redirect to `/diagnostic/signup.html?s=` (as now).
- **409 unfinished:** redirect by kind, from `detail.kind`. A drill or challenge goes to `/practice/session/?id=` (this fixes the current wrong redirect); mock, module and diagnostic go to `/test/?s=`.
- **Network error:** an inline error "Couldn't load this report." plus a "Try again" button that refetches.
- **Nothing answered:** the tiles show 0, the grid is all dashed, the mistakes heading reads "Not answered · 44", and Fix these reads "Practise all 44". The hero says "Nothing answered, so there's no estimate." and shows no gauge.
- **Old sittings without times or flags:** the time tiles show "—", the pace section is hidden, and the Flagged filter is hidden.
- **Long practice sets (up to 120 questions):** the grid wraps, the navigator uses the compact pill, and the table view is the default above 60 questions.

### 1.14 Print (`@media print`)
- Hidden: the bar, the tabs, the action buttons, the toolbar and the player.
- Printed: the hero, the tiles, modules, domains, the difficulty split, the mistakes (every row expanded), and the table view of all questions with your answer, the key and the mistake.

## 2. Results overview `/results/`

### 2.1 Header
- The H1 "Results", with a right-hand ⋯ menu: "Download CSV" (sittings) and "Print".

### 2.2 Score over time (`#overview`, full width)
**Chart (8 columns on desktop, full width on phone)**
- Each scored sitting is a vertical band (low–high) with a middle dot; the newest is orange and the others graphite.
- A dashed line at `profile.target`, labelled at its right end ("Target 700").
- The x-axis is ordered by sitting. Labels use the date, and add a time when two sittings fall on the same day ("Sep 23 6:15"). Label thinning stays as now.
- Hover or tap shows a tooltip "Sep 23 · Section · 520–660 · 31/44 · harder M2" with an "Open report" link; clicking a band opens the report.
- **Controls above the chart:**
  - Range segmented: Last 10 | 30 days | All.
  - Kind check-chips: Sections ☑ · Modules ☑ · Diagnostic ☑.
- **Legend:** "Band = estimated range · dot = middle · dashed = target".

**Facts (4 columns)**
- Latest band, big, with its kind and date.
- A delta chip: "+90 vs previous".
- "Best 550–750 · Module · Sep 23".
- "Target 700 · 40 above your latest high".
- "Exam Oct 3 · 10 days" (from the profile).

**Empty state**
- The axis frame, with a ghost band and the text "Your first test puts a point here."
- Two buttons: the pill "Full section · 70 min" and the outline "One module · 35 min". Both POST `/api/mock/new` and go to `/test/?s=`.
- A quiet link "Diagnostic · 20 questions".

### 2.3 Totals (`#totals`, 6 tiles; 3×2 on phone)
Every window is stated in the tile.
| label | value | sub-line |
|---|---|---|
| Questions | 1,284 | all time |
| Accuracy | 68% | all time · "last 14 days 72%" |
| Study time | 21 h 40 m | "this week 3 h 10 m" (includes tests after the timing fix) |
| Tests | 7 | "5 sections · 2 modules" |
| Streak | 4 days | "best 11" |
| Mistakes | 12 open | "48 fixed" |

- The Mistakes tile links to `/mistakes/`.

### 2.4 Accuracy split (`#split`)
- All-time rows for Easy / Medium / Hard and for Multiple choice / Grid-in: right/answered, % and a bar.
- Beside them: "Average time: easy 0:58 · medium 1:31 · hard 2:24". This is their contest time analysis, done here.

### 2.5 Skills (`#skills`)
- The 19 tiles, grouped by the 4 domains as now. Each tile has:
  - the glyph and name, and the mastery bar;
  - a mono line "42 answered · 71%";
  - an orange count badge "2 open" when there are traps.
- A never-practised tile reads "Not started".
- **Sort select:** By domain / Weakest first / Most open mistakes / Least practised. With any sort except By domain, the grouping flattens.
- **Clicking a tile opens the Skill panel:** a right drawer of 420px on desktop, a bottom sheet (max 85vh) on phone. It holds:
  - the name and domain;
  - the mastery bar, with the helper "A practice gauge: recent answers, hard ones counting more.";
  - "Answered 42 · Right 30 · 71%";
  - by-difficulty rows;
  - "Recent run": the last 20 answers as ✓/✕ dots, newest on the right;
  - open mistakes (label, "hit 3×", "2 to close"), each with Fix;
  - "Fixed 5";
  - "Last worked 3 days ago";
  - the last 5 sittings that included the skill, as links;
  - actions: the pill "Practise this skill" (→ `/practice/?topics=<slug>`, preselected) and the outline "Fix its mistakes · 2" (`/api/drill {mistakes:true, topics:[slug]}`).

### 2.6 Top misconceptions (`#traps`)
- The 10 most-hit traps of all time.
- Each row: the label, the topic glyph and name, "×4", "Open" or "Fixed Sep 22", and "last Sep 23".
- The heading carries a pill "Fix all open · 12" (`/api/drill {mistakes:true}`) and a link "All mistakes".
- Empty: "No mistakes yet."

### 2.7 Sittings (`#sittings`)
**Controls**
- Segmented: All 57 · Tests 9 · Practice 45 · Challenge 3.
- For Tests, a kind select: All / Section / Module / Diagnostic.
- Sort: Newest / Oldest / Highest score / Lowest score.

**In progress** (a group on top, only when there are any)
- "Section · started 6:02 AM · Module 2 · 18:22 left" with a Resume button (→ `/test/?s=`).
- "Practice set · 4 of 10" with a Resume button (→ `/practice/session/?id=`).

**Groups:** headers "This week", "Last week", then "Sep 7–13".

**Sitting card** (`UI.sittingCard`, shared with Tests)
- Desktop is one row; phone stacks it. The fields:
  - date and time;
  - kind and subtitle ("Full section · harder M2" / "Practice · Linear functions, Percentages, Circles" / "Daily challenge · #12 of 140");
  - score: the band, or "10/11 · 91%";
  - duration "64 min";
  - **wrong-question chips per module:** "M1 ✕ 1 6 7 11 15 +2" and "M2 ✕ 4 11 12 13". The overflow shows after 8 per module. Unanswered numbers get dashed chips. Each chip links to `/results/report/?id=..#q=m1-6`;
  - "3 still open" (open traps from this sitting);
  - buttons "Review" (outline) and "Fix · 7" (a quiet text button).

**Paging:** 20 per page, with "Showing 20 of 57" and "Show 20 more", using `/api/history?offset=`.

**Empty:** "Nothing finished yet.", with a "Practise" pill and a "Tests" link.

### 2.8 States
- **Loading:** skeletons.
- **API failure:** an inline error per section with "Try again". The page never falls silent as it does now (`.catch(() => [null…])` then return).
- **Brand-new learner:** the chart empty state, tiles at 0, skills all "Not started", no traps section, and the empty sittings list.
- **Lots of history:** the chart defaults to Last 10, the list is paged and grouped, and the CSV exports everything (`limit=200` loops).

## 3. Changes elsewhere, needed for this section
- **Exam runner (`web/test/test.js`):**
  - Mark for review calls `POST /api/session/{sid}/flag`.
  - `S.marked` is restored from `payload.flags` on load and on module 2.
  - The time on each question is accumulated while it is visible, and `POST /api/session/{sid}/time {times}` is sent on every question change and before finish, chained on the existing `sent` promise.
- **Practice session summary:** add a "Review every answer" outline button → `/results/report/?id=<id>`.
- **Tests page:** reuse `UI.sittingCard` for its history list.
- **Practice page:** accept `?topics=a,b` to preselect.

## 4. Accessibility
- Status is carried by glyph plus text as well as fill.
- Filters are `role=radiogroup` or `<select>`.
- The player is a `<dialog>` with focus returned on close.
- Charts have `role=img` and an aria-label summary, plus a visually-hidden data table.
- All motion is entry-only and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Touch targets are at least 44px on phone.

extras.why: Every wrong option names the misconception that produces it (Item.reasons). The player can show all of them, not just the one picked, so a student learns the whole trap family behind a question. Their explanations cannot.

Any reviewed question gets a fresh twin (same template, new seed) answered right there, and the answer can close the trap. A finite bank can only re-show the same item, whose key the student has already seen.

extras.feature: Fix these in variants (incorrect only, blanks only, each twice, just the filtered ones, per mistake)
extras.why: It turns any slice of the report into a repair set of new questions on the same templates.
The whole sitting can be sat again on the same templates with fresh seeds: a parallel test, which a paper-based bank cannot produce.

extras.feature: Live mistake status in an old report
extras.why: A miss shows 'Open · 2 clean answers to close' or 'Fixed Sep 24', read from traps now. The report reflects progress made after the sitting.
Seconds per question against the 1:35 test pace, with 'rushed misses' and 'long solves' as review filters, separates careless errors from hard ones. They only show one average.
The report shows Module 1's score, the 60% cut, which Module 2 it earned and the 580 ceiling of the easier route. Students misunderstand adaptivity, and theirs shows nothing about it.

extras.feature: Compared with last time and the target
extras.why: A delta vs the previous sitting (total and per domain), the target tick on the gauge and the distance to it make every sitting a checkpoint.

extras.feature: Accuracy by difficulty and by format, and average time by difficulty
extras.why: It shows whether the student is losing points on easy questions or on grid-ins. It has the same data as their contest 'time analysis', but on every sitting.

extras.feature: Colour the grid by difficulty or by time, and a sortable table view
extras.why: Their difficulty colouring is only in the QBank overview. The table makes a 44-question review scannable and printable.
Everyone sits the same ten, so each question can show '41% of 140 got this right'. Only a shared-seed generator makes that fair.
'Also accepted: .0496, .0497' comes from the SAT grid rule we already mark by. It teaches the entry rule that costs students points.

extras.feature: Deep links, share link, print/PDF, CSV
extras.why: A shared read-only report for a tutor or parent, a printable review, and exports. Their Share/Export button does nothing.
Mastery, the recent run, per-difficulty accuracy, open and fixed traps, and 'Practise this skill' preselected on the map.
Arrow/J/K/N/H/S/T moves through 44 questions without the mouse, as in the practice session.
Their QBank sessions never end or summarise. Every practice set here gets the same report as a test.
Their sessions survive only by URL.

extras.feature: Tests count as study time; flags survive reload
extras.why: These fix two real data holes found in the code: record_paper files ms=None, and S.marked lives only in memory.
